content: As illustrated previously, any given news article describes only a subset of most noteworthy events of a game. We observe that most reports are concise, referencing on average 5.7 events. The distribution of events/report is: 1st quantile at 3 events (20.9% of events in game), 2nd at 5 (22.2%), 3rd at 7 (38.5%), 4th at 36 (100%).
